title: A security review closed seven findings
body: A full security review closed out seven findings across the codebase: exported macro scripts can no longer be turned into executable code via a crafted recorded field, launching a custom browser executable now requires an explicit opt-in, macro repair/lint/healing stopped echoing literal credentials back at you, the takeover config write and the viewport-pill control binding are hardened against symlink-swap and unauthenticated-page-script attacks respectively, and file-upload targeting no longer defaults to the daemon's own working directory.

title: The rate limiter stops lumping every client together
body: The leader's new-session rate limiter no longer lumps every headerless MCP client into one shared bucket — a noisy direct client that skips the follower handshake can no longer 429 an unrelated client's legitimate new session.
